pm.test("sin reviewFlags ni campos de procedencia", () => { const t = JSON.stringify(j); pm.expect(t).to.not.include("reviewFlags"); pm.expect(t).to.not.include("pending"); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property("sources"); });
pm.test("displayName Lavanda; Lavanda primer nombre comun", () => { pm.expect(j.displayName).to.eql("Lavanda"); pm.expect(j.names.filter(n => n.kind === "common")[0].text).to.eql("Lavanda"); });

pm.test("useGroups: cita completa de Steinmetz", () => { const r = j.useGroups.flatMap(g => g.references).find(r => r.id === "usda_reference:Steinmetz"); pm.expect(r.citation).to.eql("Steinmetz, E.F. 1957. codex Vegetabilis. Published by the author, Amsterdam."); pm.expect(r.resolved).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("uses: etiqueta corta sin cambios", () => { pm.expect(j.uses.length).to.be.above(0); j.uses.forEach(u => pm.expect(u.reference.citation).to.match(/^USDA Dr\. Duke: referencia /)); });
pm.test("useGroups ordenados por count descendente", () => { const c = j.useGroups.map(g => g.count); pm.expect(c).to.eql([...c].sort((a, b) => b - a)); });

pm.test("credits: Wikipedia CC BY-SA 4.0 con URL de licencia; EMA con licenseUrl null", () => { const w = j.credits.find(c => c.name === "Wikipedia en español"); pm.expect(w.licenseUrl).to.eql("https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/"); pm.expect(w.url).to.eql("https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lavandula_angustifolia"); j.credits.filter(c => c.name.startsWith("EMA")).forEach(c => pm.expect(c.licenseUrl).to.eql(null)); });
